title: Sample Complexity for Markov Decision Processes and Stochastic Optimal Control with Static Risk Measures
summary: We present an elementary state augmentation method for a class of static risk measure applied to the total cost for both Markov decision processes (MDPs) and stochastic optimal control (SOC), such that dynamic programming equations can be derived on the augmented space. Through this we discuss the sample complexities of these two problem classes.
